meta.name: The Docks
meta.blurb: Refugees, the sick off the boats, and the last ship out.

activities.name: Talk to the traders
activities.blurb: Three foreign hulls still work the quay — Spanish grain, Frisian steel, and a Moorish ship no one from the town has ever boarded.

activities.name: Haul cargo
activities.blurb: Honest coin for a strong back, and half the harbour's secrets talked over your head while you sweat.
